name: 古法语学堂 (Ancien Français Duo)
description:
依据 Laurence Hélix 教材体系设计，循序渐进的古法语移动学习应用，包含多邻国风格每日打卡闯关、变格变位查询、闪卡背单词以及知名作家简介。
Based on the Laurence Hélix curriculum, this progressive Old French mobile learning app features daily check-ins and challenges in the Duolingo style, conjugation and declension lookups, flashcards for vocabulary memorization, and biographies of famous authors.
